name: Wild Fisheries Fund
summary: Five-year, GBP 1.5 million fund from the salmon farming sector for practical wild salmonid work such as barrier removal, habitat improvement and fish counters, led by fishery bodies, angling clubs and community groups.
reporting: All applicants report back on project progress and delivery after one year; projects should be completed within 18 months.

status.quote: The 2026 fund is now open and will close on 31st March 2026.

deadline.quote: The 2026 fund is now open and will close on 31st March 2026.

access.quote: Applications are invited from relevant and constituted fisheries organisations

window.quote: The programme will award funding in 2026 to projects undertaken by local fishery organisations and community bodies.
